role: Wildman-only ambient idle sound, ~1/256 chance per turn while in state 8 ("wildman idle tick").
Take-off scream for the PLAYER's own shaman (current/local tribe, 0x89C6F0, matches self+0x2F) when it first goes BLOWN - "Person physics".
Landing scream: played on touchdown for a BLOWN shaman (type 7) whose vel.y <= -100 at the moment of landing - "Person physics". Sibling of 0x9 (the non-shaman case).
Melee: Striking blow sound, warrior attacker (+0x2B==3) against a non-warrior opponent.
Melee: Striking blow sound, warrior attacker against a warrior opponent - the "weapon clang" case.
Melee: Striking, played on the OPPONENT (not the striker) every time a warrior lands a blow, regardless of the opponent's own type - layered on top of 0x27/0x2B.

Ambient crackle, every qualifying tick: played by both the cosmetic "scorched by a blast" state (26) and ordinary "on fire" (31, burn-damage) - a scorched-but-not-burning person sounds identical to one actually burning.
Firestorm/Volcano fireball impact on a WATER cell: plays with the unnamed splash effect (class 7 type 0x2B, hfx 1152) - "Fireball impact".
Take-off scream for an OTHER tribe's shaman (type 7, tribe != current/local 0x89C6F0) when it first goes BLOWN - "Person physics". Sibling of 0x1A (the player's-own-shaman case).
Landing scream: played on touchdown for a BLOWN person whose vel.y <= -100 at the moment of landing, type is not shaman (7) and not wildman (1) - "Person physics".

Played on the preach TARGET (not the preacher) when the preach order's substate reaches 8, the moment its state is set to 5 and its animation-sequence kinds get rewritten - the "being preached to" sermon payoff.
Insect Plague's invisible cloud: ambient sound played every turn while the effect is alive - its only audible trace.

Small debris/effect-burst tick sound: once per class-5 type-0xB visual-effect object spawned. Two known contexts, same pattern both times: state 19's ground-recovery settling (spawns one per 100 carried wood dropped, see person_states.tsv row 19) and preacher-conversion's roll-failure sub-state 4 ("being preached to" listening-effect burst, person_states.tsv row 23) - plausibly the same underlying "shedding/spawning small objects" primitive in both.
Firestorm/Volcano fireball impact on LAND: plays when the ground-fire scenery object ignites (0x4A8C60) - "Fireball impact".
Volcano fireball (small or big) launch kick, played once at init alongside the random horizontal/vertical velocity roll - "Volcano fireballs".
Take-off scream for a non-shaman person rising faster than 90 (vel.y > 90) when it first goes BLOWN - "Person physics". A slow/weak push gets no take-off sound at all for non-shamans.
Melee: fighter stance 2 or 4's "done" sound, played on the fighter itself when its per-type stance timer expires - no opponent-type branching (combat.md "Melee").
Played once (self+0x37 guard) when the Angel of Death's hunting AI (person state 28) allocates its own class-6 type-8 helper/trail object, on first having no live reference yet.
Melee: fighter stance 3 ("Striking")'s own blow sound against a NON-warrior opponent - sibling of 0x27 (the warrior-vs-warrior case).
